passages.text: In the first year of the reign of Belshazzar over Babylon, Daniel had a dream, and visions passed through his mind as he lay on his bed. He wrote down the dream, and this is the summary of his account.
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet in Babylon.
Belshazzar was king of Babylon.
In the first year of Belshazzar’s reign, Daniel had a dream.
Daniel saw visions in his mind while he lay on his bed.
Daniel wrote down the dream.
Daniel recorded the main points of his vision.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת חֲדָ֗ה לְבֵלְאשַׁצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל דָּנִיֵּאל֙ חֵ֣לֶם חֲזָ֔ה וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשֵׁ֖הּ עַֽל־ מִשְׁכְּבֵ֑הּ בֵּאדַ֙יִן֙ חֶלְמָ֣א כְתַ֔ב רֵ֥אשׁ מִלִּ֖ין אֲמַֽר׃

passages.text: Daniel declared: “In my vision in the night I looked, and suddenly the four winds of heaven were churning up the great sea.
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet of God.
Daniel spoke about his vision.
Daniel said he saw this vision at night.
Daniel looked and saw something happen.
He saw the four winds of heaven.
The four winds stirred up the great sea.
passages.original: עָנֵ֤ה דָנִיֵּאל֙ וְאָמַ֔ר חָזֵ֥ה הֲוֵ֛ית בְּחֶזְוִ֖י עִם־ לֵֽילְיָ֑א וַאֲר֗וּ אַרְבַּע֙ רוּחֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א מְגִיחָ֖ן לְיַמָּ֥א רַבָּֽא׃

passages.text: Then four great beasts came up out of the sea, each one different from the others: The first beast was like a lion, and it had the wings of an eagle. I watched until its wings were torn off and it was lifted up from the ground and made to stand on two feet like a man, and given the mind of a man.
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet in Babylon.
He had a vision at night.
He saw four great beasts.
The four beasts came up out of the sea.
Each beast was different from the others.
The first beast looked like a lion.
This lion had wings like an eagle.
I watched the lion.
Its wings were torn off.
The lion was lifted up from the ground.
It stood on two feet like a man.
The lion was given the mind of a man.
passages.original: וְאַרְבַּ֤ע חֵיוָן֙ רַבְרְבָ֔ן סָלְקָ֖ן מִן־ יַמָּ֑א שָׁנְיָ֖ן דָּ֥א מִן־ דָּֽא׃ קַדְמָיְתָ֣א כְאַרְיֵ֔ה וְגַפִּ֥ין דִּֽי־ נְשַׁ֖ר לַ֑הּ חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֡ית עַד֩ דִּי־ מְּרִ֨יטוּ גַפַּ֜יהּ וּנְטִ֣ילַת מִן־ אַרְעָ֗א וְעַל־ רַגְלַ֙יִן֙ כֶּאֱנָ֣שׁ הֳקִימַ֔ת וּלְבַ֥ב אֱנָ֖שׁ יְהִ֥יב לַֽהּ׃

passages.text: Suddenly another beast appeared, which looked like a bear. It was raised up on one of its sides, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. So it was told, ‘Get up and gorge yourself on flesh!’
passages.sermon:
Daniel saw a vision at night.
He saw another beast appear.
This beast looked like a bear.
The bear was raised up on one side.
It had three ribs in its mouth.
The ribs were between its teeth.
Someone spoke to the bear.
They said, "Get up and eat much flesh."
passages.original: וַאֲר֣וּ חֵיוָה֩ אָחֳרִ֨י תִנְיָנָ֜ה דָּמְיָ֣ה לְדֹ֗ב וְלִשְׂטַר־ חַד֙ הֳקִמַ֔ת וּתְלָ֥ת עִלְעִ֛ין בְּפֻמַּ֖הּ בֵּ֣ין שִׁנַּיַּהּ וְכֵן֙ אָמְרִ֣ין לַ֔הּ ק֥וּמִֽי אֲכֻ֖לִי בְּשַׂ֥ר שַׂגִּֽיא׃

passages.text: Next, as I watched, another beast appeared. It was like a leopard, and on its back it had four wings like those of a bird. The beast also had four heads, and it was given authority to rule.
passages.sermon:
Daniel saw a vision at night.
He saw four great beasts come out of the sea.
Each beast was different from the others.
The third beast appeared next.
This beast looked like a leopard.
It had four wings on its back.
The wings were like the wings of a bird.
This beast had four heads.
God gave this beast authority to rule.
passages.original: בָּאתַ֨ר דְּנָ֜ה חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֗ית וַאֲר֤וּ אָֽחֳרִי֙ כִּנְמַ֔ר וְלַ֨הּ גַּפִּ֥ין אַרְבַּ֛ע דִּי־ ע֖וֹף עַל־ גַּבַּיַּהּ וְאַרְבְּעָ֤ה רֵאשִׁין֙ לְחֵ֣יוְתָ֔א וְשָׁלְטָ֖ן יְהִ֥יב לַֽהּ׃

passages.text: After this, as I watched in my vision in the night, suddenly a fourth beast appeared, and it was terrifying—dreadful and extremely strong—with large iron teeth. It devoured and crushed; then it trampled underfoot whatever was left. It was different from all the beasts before it, and it had ten horns.
passages.sermon:
Daniel saw a vision at night.
He saw a fourth beast appear.
This beast was terrifying.
It was dreadful.
It was extremely strong.
The beast had large iron teeth.
It devoured its victims.
It crushed them.
It trampled whatever was left under its feet.
This beast was different from all the beasts that came before it.
It had ten horns.
passages.original: בָּאתַ֣ר דְּנָה֩ חָזֵ֨ה הֲוֵ֜ית בְּחֶזְוֵ֣י לֵֽילְיָ֗א וַאֲר֣וּ חֵיוָ֣ה רְבִיעָיָה דְּחִילָה֩ וְאֵֽימְתָנִ֨י וְתַקִּיפָ֜א יַתִּ֗ירָא וְשִׁנַּ֨יִן דִּֽי־ פַרְזֶ֥ל לַהּ֙ רַבְרְבָ֔ן אָֽכְלָ֣ה וּמַדֱּקָ֔ה וּשְׁאָרָ֖א בְּרַגְלַיַּהּ רָפְסָ֑ה וְהִ֣יא מְשַׁנְּיָ֗ה מִן־ כָּל־ חֵֽיוָתָא֙ דִּ֣י קָֽדָמַ֔יהּ וְקַרְנַ֥יִן עֲשַׂ֖ר לַֽהּ׃

passages.text: While I was contemplating the horns, suddenly another horn, a little one, came up among them, and three of the first horns were uprooted before it. This horn had eyes like those of a man and a mouth that spoke words of arrogance.
passages.sermon:
Daniel saw a vision at night.
He saw a fourth beast.
This beast had ten horns.
Daniel looked closely at the horns.
Suddenly, another horn appeared among them.
This new horn was small.
Three of the first horns were pulled out to make room for it.
The small horn had eyes like a man’s eyes.
The small horn had a mouth.
The mouth spoke proud and arrogant words.
passages.original: מִשְׂתַּכַּ֨ל הֲוֵ֜ית בְּקַרְנַיָּ֗א וַ֠אֲלוּ קֶ֣רֶן אָחֳרִ֤י זְעֵירָה֙ סִלְקָ֣ת בֵּינֵיהוֹן וּתְלָ֗ת מִן־ קַרְנַיָּא֙ קַדְמָ֣יָתָ֔א אֶתְעֲקַרוּ מִן־ קֳדָמַיַּהּ וַאֲל֨וּ עַיְנִ֜ין כְּעַיְנֵ֤י אֲנָשָׁא֙ בְּקַרְנָא־ דָ֔א וּפֻ֖ם מְמַלִּ֥ל רַבְרְבָֽן׃

passages.text: As I continued to watch, thrones were set in place, and the Ancient of Days took His seat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of His head was like pure wool. His throne was flaming with fire, and its wheels were all ablaze.
passages.sermon:
Daniel saw a vision at night.
He saw thrones set in place.
God appeared.
God is called the Ancient of Days.
God took His seat.
God wore clothing that was white as snow.
The hair on God’s head was like pure wool.
God’s throne was flaming with fire.
The wheels of God’s throne were all ablaze.
passages.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֗ית עַ֣ד דִּ֤י כָרְסָוָן֙ רְמִ֔יו וְעַתִּ֥יק יוֹמִ֖ין יְתִ֑ב לְבוּשֵׁ֣הּ׀ כִּתְלַ֣ג חִוָּ֗ר וּשְׂעַ֤ר רֵאשֵׁהּ֙ כַּעֲמַ֣ר נְקֵ֔א כָּרְסְיֵהּ֙ שְׁבִיבִ֣ין דִּי־ נ֔וּר גַּלְגִּלּ֖וֹהִי נ֥וּר דָּלִֽק׃

passages.text: A river of fire was flowing, coming out from His presence. Thousands upon thousands attended Him, and myriads upon myriads stood before Him. The court was convened, and the books were opened.
passages.sermon:
God is the Ancient of Days.
A river of fire flowed from His presence.
Thousands upon thousands served Him.
Myriads upon myriads stood before Him.
The court sat in judgment.
The books were opened.
passages.original: נְהַ֣ר דִּי־ נ֗וּר נָגֵ֤ד וְנָפֵק֙ מִן־ קֳדָמ֔וֹהִי אֶ֤לֶף אַלְפִים יְשַׁמְּשׁוּנֵּ֔הּ וְרִבּ֥וֹ רִבְּוָן קָֽדָמ֣וֹהִי יְקוּמ֑וּן דִּינָ֥א יְתִ֖ב וְסִפְרִ֥ין פְּתִֽיחוּ׃

passages.text: Then I kept watching because of the arrogant words the horn was speaking. As I continued to watch, the beast was slain, and its body was destroyed and thrown into the blazing fire.
passages.sermon:
Daniel saw a vision from God.
He saw a beast with a horn.
The horn spoke arrogant words.
Daniel kept watching the horn.
He saw the beast killed.
The beast’s body was destroyed.
They threw the body into the blazing fire.
passages.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית בֵּאדַ֗יִן מִן־ קָל֙ מִלַּיָּ֣א רַבְרְבָתָ֔א דִּ֥י קַרְנָ֖א מְמַלֱּלָ֑ה חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֡ית עַד֩ דִּ֨י קְטִילַ֤ת חֵֽיוְתָא֙ וְהוּבַ֣ד גִּשְׁמַ֔הּ וִיהִיבַ֖ת לִיקֵדַ֥ת אֶשָּֽׁא׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the beasts, their dominion was removed, but they were granted an extension of life for a season and a time.
passages.sermon:
The beasts were powerful creatures.
God took away their authority.
God allowed them to live longer.
God gave them more time to exist.
This extra time lasted for a set period.
God decided how long this period would be.
passages.original: וּשְׁאָר֙ חֵֽיוָתָ֔א הֶעְדִּ֖יו שָׁלְטָנְה֑וֹן וְאַרְכָ֧ה בְחַיִּ֛ין יְהִ֥יבַת לְה֖וֹן עַד־ זְמַ֥ן וְעִדָּֽן׃

passages.text: In my vision in the night I continued to watch, and I saw One like the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven. He approached the Ancient of Days and was led into His presence.
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet of God.
\r\nDaniel had a vision at night.
\r\nDaniel saw someone who looked like a Son of Man.
\r\nThis Son of Man came with the clouds of heaven.
\r\nThe Son of Man approached the Ancient of Days.
\r\nOthers led the Son of Man into the presence of the Ancient of Days.
passages.original: חָזֵ֤ה הֲוֵית֙ בְּחֶזְוֵ֣י לֵֽילְיָ֔א וַאֲרוּ֙ עִם־ עֲנָנֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א כְּבַ֥ר אֱנָ֖שׁ אָתֵ֣ה הֲוָ֑ה וְעַד־ עַתִּ֤יק יֽוֹמַיָּא֙ מְטָ֔ה וּקְדָמ֖וֹהִי הַקְרְבֽוּהִי׃

passages.text: And He was given dominion, glory, and kingship, that the people of every nation and language should serve Him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away, and His kingdom is one that will never be destroyed.
passages.sermon:
The Son of Man received authority.
He received glory.
He received kingship.
All people from every nation served Him.
All people from every language served Him.
His authority lasts forever.
No one will take away His authority.
His kingdom will never be destroyed.
passages.original: וְלֵ֨הּ יְהִ֤יב שָׁלְטָן֙ וִיקָ֣ר וּמַלְכ֔וּ וְכֹ֣ל עַֽמְמַיָּ֗א אֻמַיָּ֛א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּ֖א לֵ֣הּ יִפְלְח֑וּן שָׁלְטָנֵ֞הּ שָׁלְטָ֤ן עָלַם֙ דִּֽי־ לָ֣א יֶעְדֵּ֔ה וּמַלְכוּתֵ֖הּ דִּי־ לָ֥א תִתְחַבַּֽל׃פ

passages.text: I, Daniel, was grieved in my spirit, and the visions in my mind alarmed me.
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet of God.
Daniel saw visions from God at night.
Daniel felt deep sorrow in his spirit.
Daniel’s mind was troubled by these visions.
The visions alarmed Daniel.
passages.original: אֶתְכְּרִיַּ֥ת רוּחִ֛י אֲנָ֥ה דָנִיֵּ֖אל בְּג֣וֹא נִדְנֶ֑ה וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖י יְבַהֲלֻנַּֽנִי׃

passages.text: I approached one of those who were standing there, and I asked him the true meaning of all this. So he told me the interpretation of these things: ‘These four great beasts are four kings who will arise from the earth.
passages.sermon:
Daniel saw a vision.
Daniel wanted to understand the vision.
Daniel approached one of those who were standing there.
Daniel asked him for the true meaning of all this.
The one standing there answered Daniel.
He explained the meaning to Daniel.
He said, “These four great beasts are four kings.
These four kings will arise from the earth.”
passages.original: קִרְבֵ֗ת עַל־ חַד֙ מִן־ קָ֣אֲמַיָּ֔א וְיַצִּיבָ֥א אֶבְעֵֽא־ מִנֵּ֖הּ עַֽל־ כָּל־ דְּנָ֑ה וַאֲמַר־ לִ֕י וּפְשַׁ֥ר מִלַּיָּ֖א יְהוֹדְעִנַּֽנִי׃ אִלֵּין֙ חֵיוָתָ֣א רַבְרְבָתָ֔א דִּ֥י אִנִּ֖ין אַרְבַּ֑ע אַרְבְּעָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְקוּמ֥וּן מִן־ אַרְעָֽא׃

passages.text: But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom and possess it forever—yes, forever and ever.’
passages.sermon:
The saints belong to the Most High God.
God will give the kingdom to these saints.
The saints will receive the kingdom.
The saints will possess the kingdom.
They will keep the kingdom forever.
They will have the kingdom for all time.
They will have the kingdom forever and ever.
passages.original: וִֽיקַבְּלוּן֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔א קַדִּישֵׁ֖י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין וְיַחְסְנ֤וּן מַלְכוּתָא֙ עַֽד־ עָ֣לְמָ֔א וְעַ֖ד עָלַ֥ם עָלְמַיָּֽא׃

passages.text: Then I wanted to know the true meaning of the fourth beast, which was different from all the others—extremely terrifying—devouring and crushing with iron teeth and bronze claws, then trampling underfoot whatever was left.
passages.sermon:
Daniel saw a vision.
Daniel saw four great beasts.
The fourth beast was different from the others.
The fourth beast was extremely terrifying.
The fourth beast had iron teeth.
The fourth beast had bronze claws.
The fourth beast devoured its victims.
The fourth beast crushed what it ate.
The fourth beast trampled whatever was left under its feet.
Daniel wanted to know the true meaning of this fourth beast.
passages.original: אֱדַ֗יִן צְבִית֙ לְיַצָּבָ֔א עַל־ חֵֽיוְתָא֙ רְבִיעָ֣יְתָ֔א דִּֽי־ הֲוָ֥ת שָֽׁנְיָ֖ה מִן־ כָּלְּהוֹן דְּחִילָ֣ה יַתִּ֗ירָה שִׁנַּיַּהּ דִּֽי־ פַרְזֶל֙ וְטִפְרַ֣יהּ דִּֽי־ נְחָ֔שׁ אָֽכְלָ֣ה מַדֲּקָ֔ה וּשְׁאָרָ֖א בְּרַגְלַ֥יהּ רָֽפְסָֽה׃

passages.text: I also wanted to know about the ten horns on its head and the other horn that came up, before which three of them fell—the horn whose appearance was more imposing than the others, with eyes and with a mouth that spoke words of arrogance.
passages.sermon:
Daniel saw a vision of a fourth beast.
This beast had ten horns on its head.
Daniel wanted to know about these ten horns.
Another horn came up after the ten.
Three of the first horns fell before this new horn.
This new horn looked more imposing than the others.
This horn had eyes.
This horn had a mouth.
This horn spoke arrogant words.
passages.original: וְעַל־ קַרְנַיָּ֤א עֲשַׂר֙ דִּ֣י בְרֵאשַׁ֔הּ וְאָחֳרִי֙ דִּ֣י סִלְקַ֔ת וּנְפַלוּ מִן־ קֳדָמַיַּהּ תְּלָ֑ת וְקַרְנָ֨א דִכֵּ֜ן וְעַיְנִ֣ין לַ֗הּ וְפֻם֙ מְמַלִּ֣ל רַבְרְבָ֔ן וְחֶזְוַ֖הּ רַ֥ב מִן־ חַבְרָתַֽהּ׃

passages.text: As I watched, this horn was waging war against the saints and prevailing against them, until the Ancient of Days arrived and pronounced judgment in favor of the saints of the Most High, and the time came for them to possess the kingdom.
passages.sermon:
A horn appeared.
This horn fought against the saints.
The horn defeated the saints.
The Ancient of Days arrived.
The Ancient of Days judged in favor of the saints of the Most High.
The time came for the saints to receive the kingdom.
passages.original: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית וְקַרְנָ֣א דִכֵּ֔ן עָבְדָ֥ה קְרָ֖ב עִם־ קַדִּישִׁ֑ין וְיָכְלָ֖ה לְהֽוֹן׃ עַ֣ד דִּֽי־ אֲתָ֗ה עַתִּיק֙ יֽוֹמַיָּ֔א וְדִינָ֣א יְהִ֔ב לְקַדִּישֵׁ֖י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין וְזִמְנָ֣א מְטָ֔ה וּמַלְכוּתָ֖א הֶחֱסִ֥נוּ קַדִּישִֽׁין׃

passages.text: This is what he said: ‘The fourth beast is a fourth kingdom that will appear on the earth, different from all the other kingdoms, and it will devour the whole earth, trample it down, and crush it.
passages.sermon:
The fourth beast is a symbol.
It stands for a fourth kingdom.
This kingdom will rise on the earth.
It will be different from all the other kingdoms.
This kingdom will devour the whole earth.
It will trample the earth.
It will crush the earth.
passages.original: כֵּן֮ אֲמַר֒ חֵֽיוְתָא֙ רְבִיעָ֣יְתָ֔א מַלְכ֤וּ רְבִיעָיָא תֶּהֱוֵ֣א בְאַרְעָ֔א דִּ֥י תִשְׁנֵ֖א מִן־ כָּל־ מַלְכְוָתָ֑א וְתֵאכֻל֙ כָּל־ אַרְעָ֔א וּתְדוּשִׁנַּ֖הּ וְתַדְּקִנַּֽהּ׃

passages.text: And the ten horns are ten kings who will rise from this kingdom. After them another king, different from the earlier ones, will rise and subdue three kings.
passages.sermon:
The ten horns represent ten kings.
These ten kings will come from this kingdom.
After these ten kings, another king will appear.
This new king will be different from the earlier kings.
He will bring down three of the kings.
passages.original: וְקַרְנַיָּ֣א עֲשַׂ֔ר מִנַּהּ֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔ה עַשְׂרָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְקֻמ֑וּן וְאָחֳרָ֞ן יְק֣וּם אַחֲרֵיה֗וֹן וְה֤וּא יִשְׁנֵא֙ מִן־ קַדְמָיֵ֔א וּתְלָתָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְהַשְׁפִּֽל׃

passages.text: He will speak out against the Most High and oppress the saints of the Most High, intending to change the appointed times and laws; and the saints will be given into his hand for a time, and times, and half a time.
passages.sermon:
A king will rise from the fourth kingdom.
This king will be different from the earlier kings.
He will speak against the Most High God.
He will attack the saints who belong to the Most High God.
He will try to change the set times and the laws.
God will allow the saints to be handed over to this king.
This will last for a time, times, and half a time.
passages.original: וּמִלִּ֗ין לְצַ֤ד עִלָּיָא יְמַלִּ֔ל וּלְקַדִּישֵׁ֥י עֶלְיוֹנִ֖ין יְבַלֵּ֑א וְיִסְבַּ֗ר לְהַשְׁנָיָה֙ זִמְנִ֣ין וְדָ֔ת וְיִתְיַהֲב֣וּן בִּידֵ֔הּ עַד־ עִדָּ֥ן וְעִדָּנִ֖ין וּפְלַ֥ג עִדָּֽן׃

passages.text: But the court will convene, and his dominion will be taken away and completely destroyed forever.
passages.sermon:
God is the Most High.
God will judge all things.
A court will sit in judgment.
The court will take away the king’s power.
The court will destroy his rule completely.
His dominion will end forever.
passages.original: וְדִינָ֖א יִתִּ֑ב וְשָׁלְטָנֵ֣הּ יְהַעְדּ֔וֹן לְהַשְׁמָדָ֥ה וּלְהוֹבָדָ֖ה עַד־ סוֹפָֽא׃

passages.text: Then the sovereignty, dominion, and greatness of the kingdoms under all of heaven will be given to the people, the saints of the Most High. His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom, and all rulers will serve and obey Him.’
passages.sermon:
God is the Most High.
God has saints.
The saints are God's holy people.
All kingdoms under heaven have power, rule, and greatness.
God will give this power, rule, and greatness to His saints.
God will give the kingdoms to His people.
God's kingdom will last forever.
God's kingdom will never end.
All rulers will serve God.
All rulers will obey God.
passages.original: וּמַלְכוּתָ֨ה וְשָׁלְטָנָ֜א וּרְבוּתָ֗א דִּ֚י מַלְכְוָת֙ תְּח֣וֹת כָּל־ שְׁמַיָּ֔א יְהִיבַ֕ת לְעַ֖ם קַדִּישֵׁ֣י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין מַלְכוּתֵהּ֙ מַלְכ֣וּת עָלַ֔ם וְכֹל֙ שָׁלְטָ֣נַיָּ֔א לֵ֥הּ יִפְלְח֖וּן וְיִֽשְׁתַּמְּעֽוּן׃

passages.text: Thus ends the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts troubled me greatly, and my face turned pale. But I kept the matter to myself.”
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet who received visions from God.
This is the end of the matter.
My name is Daniel.
My thoughts troubled me very much.
My face became pale.
I kept the matter in my heart.
I did not tell anyone.
passages.original: עַד־ כָּ֖ה סוֹפָ֣א דִֽי־ מִלְּתָ֑א אֲנָ֨ה דָֽנִיֵּ֜אל שַׂגִּ֣יא׀ רַעְיוֹנַ֣י יְבַהֲלֻנַּ֗נִי וְזִיוַי֙ יִשְׁתַּנּ֣וֹן עֲלַ֔י וּמִלְּתָ֖א בְּלִבִּ֥י נִטְרֵֽת׃פ
